verdict.rationale: A state business registry could plausibly publish bulk registry extracts, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only per-entity lookups (name search, entity status check, certificate validation) and a viewable list of registered agents, none of which is a downloadable bulk dataset or extract. The entry page is also gated by a CAPTCHA, and probes found no machine-readable endpoints.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
